cases.given: Jackage source and all authorized local inputs exist.
cases.when: Build, test, package, local publish, install, run, rollback, and collect execute.
cases.then: Every stage produces actual evidence through the public interfaces.

cases.title: Resume agent work
cases.given: An agent stops after a partial milestone.
cases.when: A new OMP session reads the handoff.
cases.then: It resumes the exact next test without repeating a destructive setup.

cases.title: Replay clean checkout
cases.given: A release candidate and locks exist.
cases.when: Independent CI rebuilds and tests from clean state.
cases.then: Results identify exact source, tools, platform, and executed commands.

cases.title: Reject fake coverage
cases.given: Required cases contain only mocks, skipped tests, or documentation.
cases.then: It refuses full delivery.

cases.title: Reproduce without result cache
cases.given: Equal declared release inputs exist on independent workers.
cases.when: Both execute with fresh action results.
cases.then: Declared unsigned artifact bytes match or the claim fails.

cases.title: Exercise recovery matrix
cases.given: Persistent operations have crash injection points.
cases.then: Trust, store, profile, and lease state remain consistent.

cases.title: Exercise malicious inputs
cases.given: Minimized parser, archive, metadata, and protocol attack fixtures exist.
cases.when: Regression and bounded fuzz runs execute.
cases.then: No known crash, escape, or unauthorized acceptance remains.

cases.title: Review dependencies
cases.given: The complete bootstrap and runtime dependency graph exists.
cases.then: Provenance and redistribution blockers are explicit.

cases.title: Validate performance report
cases.given: Fixed benchmark definitions and raw measurements exist.
cases.then: Claimed execution and reclaim results match evidence.

cases.title: Publish support matrix
cases.given: Native evidence is missing for a target.
cases.when: Release metadata and documentation are generated.
cases.then: The target remains unsupported or blocked rather than silently claimed.

cases.title: Verify user documentation
cases.given: Installation, migration, recovery, and rollback instructions exist.
cases.when: A clean disposable environment follows them.
cases.then: Commands match actual behavior and no undocumented manual step is required.

cases.title: Retain publication boundary
cases.given: All release gates pass without production authority.
cases.then: No public upload, push, signing operation, or paid resource creation occurs automatically.
